resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR record says the tower was reconstructed and faithfully restored; firelookout.com says Bruce re-erected only the top 28 feet. The sources do not say how much of the original frame was reused, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates: the original Sawyer Ridge record (45.68417, -115.95504) and the NHLR coordinates for the relocated Eyeful Tower (45.684020, -115.955446) are about 35 m apart. The sources do not say the original tower stood where the Dreher home is now, so check before reusing the original coordinates. No recent photo or status check was found for the relocated tower. The Idaho Fire Lookouts 'Drive-Up' label is not used because the tower is on private property.
